title: Mountain Crabs
hook: Player-safe note: Granite-shelled cliff crabs with moss and alpine flowers growing on their backs, stone-heavy claws, many gripping legs, and wary eyes made for vertical roads.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Huge stone-shelled crabs adapted to cliffs, granite armor, moss and small alpine flowers, many legs gripping rock, and beadlike wary eyes.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Grumpy granite tenants of the cliff with gardens growing on their own backs. Not malicious, just enormous and territorial on a road where one bad step is the last. They were here long before the climbing route and resent the traffic.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Falling, fire, and the vibration of too many boots drumming on their rock.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
